localization.TOURS.StoryTagSidebarDescription: Learn how to manage story tags, statuses, Limits, and Actors.
localization.TOURS.StoryTagSidebarIntroContent: The Story Tag Sidebar replaces the combat tracker. Use it to manage shared story tags, statuses, Limits, and Actors in play.
localization.TOURS.StoryTagSidebarTabContent:
Click the tags tab to open the sidebar. Right-click the icon to open it in a separate window.

Keyboard shortcut: T (open or close the sidebar window)
localization.TOURS.StoryTagSidebarStorySectionContent: The top section lists story tags shared with everyone. Any character can interact with them.
localization.TOURS.StoryTagSidebarAddButtonsContent:
Type in the quick-add box and press Enter, or click Add:

• Plain text → story tag
• -N suffix (1–6) → status at tier N
• :N suffix → Limit with maximum N
localization.TOURS.StoryTagSidebarTagItemContent: A story tag records a fact such as "Dark Alley" or "Raining". Click its name to edit it. The hourglass marks a tag as single-use.
localization.TOURS.StoryTagSidebarStatusItemContent: A status has up to 6 tiers. Check boxes to raise its tier. The highest positive and negative statuses affect a roll's Power.
localization.TOURS.StoryTagSidebarAddActorContent: Drag an Actor from the sidebar or click Add Actor to show that Actor's tags and statuses.
localization.TOURS.StoryTagSidebarSummaryContent:
Drag a tag from this sidebar onto a roll window to invoke it. Right-click a tag to burn, convert, or remove it.

T = open or close the sidebar window
